svg.title: fig01 world map
svg.desc: Global DPP landscape: evidence coverage Selected legal, standards and ecosystem records | Release 0.1.0 | Evidence cut-off: 23 October 2026 A GEOGRAPHIC COVERAGE Country-level extraction 17 countries with direct records 26 countries: EU-scope joins only No country-level record / not assessed 44 country rows; 1 has no country-level record. European detail B TRANSNATIONAL SCOPE Global standards and ecosystems W3C DPP & Business Wallet TF Active task force; vocabulary work evolving. ISO/IEC JTC 5 Active international DPP committee. UN Transparency Protocol 0.7.0 maintained pilot release. Global Battery Alliance Active battery passport programme. RAIN-DPP-001 Published non-normative guidance. European scope CEN-CENELEC JTC 24 Europe: horizontal DPP standards. CIRPASS-2 EU: research and implementation pilots. Examples are not assigned to countries or treated as domestic legal obligations. Coverage is not a legal-readiness ranking. Small states and territorial scopes require the accompanying table.
